fix(vercel): build error — async_hooks + force-dynamic for webhook routes

Fixes Vercel build error: Failed to collect page data for
/api/delivery/webhook/glovo

Fix 1: Logger async_hooks bypass
  - Changed require('async_hooks') to eval('require')('async_hooks')
  - Prevents webpack from statically analyzing the require call
  - Fixes root cause for ALL routes that import logger

Fix 2: force-dynamic on webhook routes
  - Added export const dynamic = force-dynamic to Glovo + Wolt routes
  - Public webhook endpoints should never be statically prerendered
